QuestInfo.name: [Vanishing Journey] Lying in Repose
QuestInfo.0: While flying over the Fire Zone Skyline, Kao suddenly attacks, causing you and Rino to fall. Fortunately, the two of you land atop a mound of soft sand. When you regain conscious, you find yourself inside a cave.
QuestInfo.1: While flying over the Fire Zone Skyline, Kao suddenly attacks, causing you and Rino to fall. Fortunately, the two of you land atop a mound of soft sand. When you regain conscious, you find yourself inside a cave.
QuestInfo.2: Why did Kao attack you and Rino? All that matters right now is escaping the Cave of Repose... According to Rino, the cave's exit is will lead you to the end of the Vanishing Journey.

0.msg: #h0#, you're awake! It's a good thing we landed on this soft sand...

1.msg: Ugh, my ankle... I-it's nothing. Don't worry about me. Just worry about escaping this cave.

2.msg: #b(Kao's actions weigh on your mind, but there are more important matters at hand.)#k

3.msg: This place is the last stop along the Vanishing Journey... The Cave of Repose. Traveling through this cave will lead you to what lies beyond. We're almost there.

4.msg: It's practically a maze in here but... I know a shortcut to the cave's exit. Now, follow me.

0.msg: #b(Rino limped off to the right. You should follow her.)#k

no.0: We can't stay here long. I don't want to scare you, but... This cavern is a place of rest for those that are vanishing from existence... The longer we stay here, the more we're risking our own existence.
no.1: Heh. There's no need for you to worry. You're safe as long as you're with me.
